integrity: An explicit infinite-family proof is accompanied by finite exhaustive corroboration. Independent scientific validation and independent priority certification have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The code guarantees recovery of ordinary message Hamming weight after two cyclic pair errors, not full-message recovery. No corresponding claim for more errors or other alphabets. Two relevant full texts were inaccessible; older implicit coverage remains a priority risk.
title: Exact two-pair-error redundancy for the binary Hamming-weight function
